what: Seller reports that after four months on Gumroad with organic sales of low-ticket digital downloads, support did not respond to multiple emails about a payout verification failure.
verbatim_snippet: "I sent multiple emails to Gumroad's support team. I explained the issue. I asked what I needed to do to fix it. I followed every instruction I saw online — verifying, re-verifying, checking settings, checking bank details."
notes: Recovery method: Google search index snippet. Author is Anita Sharma. Direct fetch returned 403. The "four months no proper reply" and "cannot recommend Gumroad" conclusions appear in separate passages of the same article.
